timing: Paid same visit via prepaid debit card (automatic deposits)
eligibility: US 18+ (19+ in some states), 110+ lbs, pass medical screening and physical exam, valid ID + proof of address/SSN; twice-weekly max, one day apart
steps: Find a CSL Plasma center (300+ centers) and schedule or walk in
Bring valid ID, proof of address, and SSN
Pass the medical screening and physical exam on first visit (2-3 hours)
Complete donation; payment loads to CSL prepaid debit card same visit
Donate up to twice per week; new-donor bonus paid across first-month donations
catches: First visit takes 2-3 hours with screening and physical; not everyone qualifies.
Pay varies by location and promotion — official page says '*Varies by location and is subject to change'.
CSL pays on weight tiers: heavier donors earn more per visit.
Must donate at the same center/promotion window to earn the full first-month bonus.
biggest_catch: The '$800 first month' figure requires completing up to 8 donations in the first month and varies by location — individual visit pay is $50-$100 depending on weight tier and promotion.

repeatable.cadence: Up to twice per week with at least 1 day between donations, for as long as you keep passing the health screening — the $800 first-month new-donor bonus itself is one-time per person.
repeatable.note: Ongoing: donors can donate up to twice per week indefinitely at regular per-visit pay. The new-donor first-month bonus itself is one-time per person.

maximize: Donate the full 8 first-month donations as fast as allowed (twice a week, at least 1 day apart) so the $800 new-donor bonus lands before it expires. Always do BOTH weekly donations — two donations a week is what unlocks the full monthly total. Ask your center about the iGive Rewards referral program before bringing friends.

who_pays: CSL Plasma pays you directly, loaded onto a CSL prepaid debit card — similar to a debit card — that you receive after your first donation.
who_qualifies: You must be 18 or older (19 in some states), weigh at least 110 lbs, and pass a medical screening and physical exam. Bring a valid ID, proof of address, and your SSN. You are re-screened every visit — failing the health check means no donation and no pay that day.
work_available: CSL Plasma operates 300+ centers across 41 states — a normally operating business, not a limited-time gig. The $800 new-donor first-month promotion varies by location and is subject to change, so confirm your center's current bonus window before your first visit.
what_gets_accepted: A completed, successful donation: you must pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. Being deferred at screening — low protein or iron, high blood pressure, or other flags — means no pay for that visit.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit takes 2-3 hours (screening plus physical plus donation) before you earn anything. Return visits run about 90-180 minutes including waiting. This involves a needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips to the center, and your own travel — none of the screening or waiting time is paid.
when_cash_arrives: Payment is loaded onto your CSL prepaid debit card the same visit, automatically — the official page says "Use your funds right away."
